verses.text: 497. The Gospel accounts understand the virginal conception of Jesus as a divine work that surpasses all human understanding and possibility: (Mt 1:18-25; Lk 1:26-38.) “That which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit,” said the angel to Joseph about Mary his fiancée. (Mt 1:20.) The Church sees here the fulfilment of the divine promise given through the prophet Isaiah: “Behold, a virgin shall conceive and bear a son.” (Is 7:14; Mt 1:23.)
